official_identity: The current IHS Santa Fe Service Unit page identifies the Santa Fe Indian Health Center at 1700 Cerrillos Road, Santa Fe, NM 87505. CMS identifies the CCN at the same street address as Santa Fe PHS Indian Hospital and Government - Federal.
regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30 deems federally owned or operated hospitals, including hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, in compliance with Part 180.
interpretation: CMS ownership and exact-address agreement with the current IHS facility page support the federal scope disposition. The IHS page currently describes an outpatient service unit; this is not a claim about MRF availability or file quality.
next_action: Retain the federal scope exclusion unless CMS ownership or regulatory scope changes.
